turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Here’s how exchanges work for gifts from Faherty: - The recipient can exchange the gift for a different size or return it for store credit within 60 days of purchase. - Exchanges and returns can be done online using the [Returns Center](https://fahertybrand.loopreturns.com/#/)—just select “Received a gift? Start here” and follow the prompts. - They’ll need the order number (from the packing slip) and shipping zip code. - Exchanges can also be made at any Faherty store location. For example, you can save 20% when you add two or more High Standard Fleece items to your cart. - Discounts cannot be combined, and there isn’t a general discount for adding a second smaller item unless it’s part of a specific bundle promotion.
